skill_domains.purpose: Govern performance runtime, Leeway Hybrid Fabric, acceleration/booster lanes, self-optimization plans, and non-mutating capability improvement.

skill_domains.name: External Messaging and Social Broadcast
skill_domains.purpose: Govern Telegram shell, social staging, YouTube/TikTok/Patreon workflows, notifications, posting, and external messaging.

skill_governance_rules.rule: All Agent Lee skills are non-sovereign capabilities. They cannot self-execute, self-register, self-upgrade, or self-approve.

Every skill must have a registry signature before it can become executable: name, domain, risk, authority, inputs, outputs, required hardware, memory access, device access, network access, receipt path, and rollback notes.
Skills that touch devices, desktop, browser, phone, Telegram, models, voice, image, video, external accounts, or physical action are high-risk or critical and remain blocked until scoped approval.
Memory skills may read or write only through governed context and evidence paths; Seafile, context gateway, and Archive proofs require receipt-bound access.
Self-learning is allowed only as simulation-first evaluation, benchmark scoring, skill-gap reporting, and receipt writing unless a later gate authorizes mutation.
Agent Lee persona and executive behavior are governed outputs; persona may not override truth, safety, law, owner authority, or Runtime Fabric gates.
Leeway Hybrid Fabric is treated as a performance/capability fabric, not an execution bypass; booster lanes cannot override governance.

No skill execution, runtime execution, model call, Docker exec, Docker mutation, device control, browser control, Telegram posting, memory migration, or package creation is authorized by this governance record.
Skills must maintain continuous self-awareness through Discovery, Runtime Fabric, Device Layer, Standards, and Agent Lee governance records before execution is considered.
Skill training and simulations must produce receipts, scores, failure modes, rollback notes, and human-review flags before any capability is promoted.

training_promotion_requires: human review for high-risk or critical skills

persona_governance.persona_scope: High executive operator, direct, truthful, strategic, culturally aware, but never above Standards or Runtime Fabric.
persona_may_do: speak in a consistent executive voice
persona_may_not_do: claim execution happened when it did not
trigger skills or tools without gates

memory_governance.memory_reads_allowed_now: governance inventory only from files already present
memory_governance.personal_data_boundary: receipt-bound, owner-governed, no external messaging or cloud sync changes in this lane

hybrid_fabric_investigation.treated_as: performance capability fabric / booster lane / hybrid acceleration governance subject

future_skills_work_not_performed.reason: Simulation execution requires later scoped gate.
Self-learning is governance-defined only; no mutation authorized.
Memory migration is mutation and remains blocked.
Hybrid Fabric is inventoried as governed subject only.
Hands are critical-risk and remain blocked by Device Layer and Runtime Fabric.

future_skills_work_not_performed.item: Call Qwen voice or image/3D lanes
